requirements.statement: No schema version change and no owner step: an older release with the same ledger schema still opens, reads and appends to an indexed account-ledger copy; while none exists, older releases refuse with zero writes (B4t H1d; decision 348).
The candidate evidence-link check looks up linked records by identity using an additive index, with flat SQLite VM work for fixed links as unrelated records grow.
Preserve candidate evidence results, linked-evidence and history order, and admission checks exactly as before the indexed replacement.
